component.name: Demido Studio
component.summary: An AI workspace that runs on your own computer

description.p: Demido Studio runs AI models on your own computer, set up for your graphics card, and connects to Google Gemini or OpenRouter when you want a model in the cloud.

ul.li: Local models from the Qwen and Gemma families, on NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Vulkan or the CPU
Tools that work together: market data, your email, Python, your own programs and files
Every answer shows exactly what was sent to the model and what came back
